Then the boat turned toward the open sea, carrying its impossible passenger home.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把梧桐的影子铺在空荡的人行道上，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的微光。巷口的早餐铺亮起灯，蒸汽托着面香升上夜空。一个骑车的人缩紧衣领，穿过安静的路口。远处医院仍有窗户明亮，河面漂着最后几颗星。天还没亮，生活已经轻轻翻身。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
